caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table set against a plain, light-colored background. The table has a rectangular top and four tapered legs, all rendered in various shades of brown to simulate the texture and grain of aged wood. The table is shown in three-quarter perspective, with the tabletop slightly angled, revealing two sides and three legs fully, while the fourth leg is partially obscured. The wood surface features visible marks, scratches, and areas of lighter and darker coloring, suggesting wear and use. There is no other object or detail in the composition apart from the table, and the background remains uniformly blank except for the artist's signature, "ARTHUR STEWART", located in the bottom right corner.
title: Desk
